LSO.note: Document states no authentication, e-signature or PKI service.
Document states no link between civil register and ID system in service or planned.
Document gives 70% death registration and a need to digitise older documents, but names no digital civil register.

facts.fact: UNDP reports the IEC registers voters through Mobile Registration Devices and an outsourced Voter Registration Management System, with 1,388,207 voters on the roll as of September 2023.

systems.platform: outsourced software; IEC holds no source key

LSO.note: 95% is of the targeted citizens, about 1.4 million, with no share of the whole population.
Document states no number given at birth.
Document says nothing on who operates or owns the national ID system; the outsourced software is the voter system.
Document says the voter roll lacks a unique identifier and is not keyed on the national ID.

facts.fact: UNDP reports Home Affairs says it has registered 95% of targeted citizens, approaching 1.4 million, capturing ten fingerprints and a photo, with charge-free ID issuance and continuous data update.

systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs, National Identity and Civil Registration Department

LSO.note: Document only recommends reviewing technology and cyber security standards.
Document is not about local government offices.
Document names no digital entry at local civil registration offices.
